inputs.prompt: One original Mirror-Keel Reaver facing RIGHT in the same elevated three-quarter orthographic fantasy strategy game view. A lean armored spectral humanoid with exactly TWO arms, TWO hands, TWO legs and TWO armored clawed feet. Layered dark silver-blue plate armor, ivory split beak-like mask on a tall dark spiked helmet, two violet lantern ornaments at the helmet sides, and a long ragged teal sailcloth cape flowing behind. The cape is CLOTH, not wings or extra limbs. RIGHT hand on screen-left holds ONE long rigid gently curved silver saber by its short hilt; preserve its full continuous blade and pointed tip. LEFT hand on screen-right holds ONE separate short silver crescent boarding hook with a dark grip. These two distinct weapons NEVER swap hands, multiply, fuse or change shape. Preserve both real grips, mask, armor joints, lanterns, clawed feet, and tattered cape. Locked camera, fixed anatomical scale, full figure and both weapons inside frame. Stable ground baseline. Flat uniform saturated GREEN background RGB0,255,0, constant neutral lighting. No scenery, shadows painted on the plate, camera movement, flashes, magic, particles, beams, or action swoosh lines. One short forward fencing THRUST and withdrawal, with a narrow bare steel blade visible throughout. Begin at ready. The right elbow folds to draw the saber hilt up to the chest, its point aimed forward to the right. The right shoulder and elbow extend together to push the pointed saber forward into the supplied extended-arm pose. Briefly hold the fully extended blade, then pull the same hand back toward the chest and lower the point to ready. This is a forward and backward linear arm movement, not a sweeping cut. The saber is a physical thin solid metal object moving slowly with the wrist, its edge and tip clearly separated from the green plate. Left hand keeps its separate small hook tucked beside the waist. Knees flex subtly; feet remain planted. Crisp still-photograph clarity at every instant. No overhead windup, no arcing slash, no flourishes, no motion trails, no drawn light shapes, no effects or particles. Show only the armored character, its two physical weapons and the flat green plate.
